hero.lede: Binaya helps property managers in Salalah handle reservations, payments, and operations across every building — in one place. Free for one building. Ready in 20 minutes.
hero.socialProof: Trusted by property managers across Salalah, Mirbat & Al Haffa

problem.title: Sound familiar?
problem.description: Most property managers in Salalah run their business on three tools: a spreadsheet, a WhatsApp group, and good memory. It works — until Khareef starts.
problem.lostBody: Your receptionist does not know which units are available across buildings — and the caller hangs up.
problem.sheetBody: Reservations in one sheet, payments in another, expenses in a third. Three people, three versions of the truth.
problem.carBody: Hours wasted approving expenses in person and checking cash boxes that should already be reconciled.
problem.reconBody: Counting cash that does not match the receipts, every single night, in the back office.

solution.title: Built for the way you actually work.
solution.description: Binaya PMS handles every part of property management — from the first phone call to the monthly P&L — so you can stop firefighting and start running the business.
solution.calendarTitle: See every unit at a glance
solution.calendarBody: Color-coded availability across all your buildings. Find any vacant night in seconds — even when the phone rings on a Friday afternoon.
solution.pricingBody: Automatic rate changes for Khareef season. Maximise revenue during your busiest months without spreadsheet juggling.
solution.deviceBody: Approve expenses from your phone. Check dashboards from home. Run your business from the gardens of Al Haffa if you want.

featureReservations.title: Never miss a booking again.
featureReservations.description: Create a reservation in under 30 seconds. Daily or monthly stays, mix multiple units in one booking, automatic pricing with Khareef rates already baked in.
featureReservations.b5: Real-time availability — no double bookings, ever

featureFinance.title: Track every riyal — to three decimals.
featureFinance.description: Built for Omani Rial from day one. Invoices generate themselves, payments record in cash or card or transfer, and your cashier reconciliation takes two minutes instead of two hours.
featureFinance.b1: Multi-method payments — cash, card, bank transfer
featureFinance.b2: Auto invoice generation with VAT & Khareef rates
featureFinance.b3: Tenant ledger with full payment history

featureReports.title: Know your business at a glance.
featureReports.description: Three dashboards for three perspectives. Your receptionist sees today's tasks. Your accountant sees the books. You see the whole picture — across every building.
featureReports.b5: Export to PDF or Excel · Khareef analytics

featureExpenses.title: Approve expenses from your phone.
featureExpenses.description: The receptionist photographs the receipt. You approve with one tap, from the back seat of the car. No more driving to a building just to sign off on cleaning supplies.
featureExpenses.b1: Submit expenses with a receipt photo

oman.title: Made in Oman. For Oman.
oman.description: Other property software treats Oman as an afterthought — an extra currency setting, a half-baked translation. Binaya was built specifically for how property runs in Salalah.
oman.arabicBody: Native Arabic interface with proper right-to-left layout. Train your team in their preferred language — receptionist by receptionist.
oman.omrBody: Built for Omani Rial with proper 3-decimal precision. No conversion errors, no confusing dollar signs slipping into invoices.
oman.khareefBody: Seasonal pricing, occupancy forecasting, peak-season dashboards. Built around how Salalah's rental economy actually works.

how.title: From signup to first reservation in three steps.
how.description: No implementation consultant. No training week. Most of our customers create their first real booking the same afternoon they sign up.
how.step1Body: Create your account in two minutes. No credit card needed. No sales call required.
how.step2Body: Tell us about your units and pricing. Or upload your existing spreadsheet — we will import it for you.
how.step3Body: Create reservations, generate invoices, and watch the chaos turn into a dashboard.

testimonials.title: What property managers are saying.
testimonials.description: Real feedback from operators across Salalah, Mirbat, and Al Haffa — the people Binaya was built with, not just for.
testimonials.t1Quote: We tracked Khareef bookings on spreadsheets for five years. Binaya replaced everything in a week, and we are already seeing fewer lost bookings during the rush.
testimonials.t2Quote: Finally a system that understands how Omani property managers actually work. The Khareef pricing alone saves me hours every season — and probably catches OMR 800 in revenue I used to lose.
testimonials.t3Quote: My receptionists love it. My accountant loves it. I can approve expenses from the car. It just works — and it speaks Arabic, which my team appreciates.

pricing.title: Free to start. Scale as you grow.
pricing.description: No setup fees. No per-reservation charges. No surprise invoices at the end of the year. Cancel anytime.
pricing.freeTagline: Perfect for single-building operators getting started.
pricing.freeF6: Free forever — no card on file
pricing.proTagline: For growing property businesses across 2 buildings.
pricing.bizTagline: For multi-building operations and growing portfolios.

rtl.title: Same product. Both directions.
rtl.description: Every screen, every form, every report flips right-to-left without a single missing translation or broken layout. Train your team in their preferred language.
rtl.footer: Every number stays LTR · every chevron flips · every date uses the right calendar conventions.

faq.title: Everything you might ask.
faq.description: The straight answers we wish we had had when we evaluated property software.
faq.q1: Is Binaya really free for one building?
faq.a1: Yes. The free tier covers a single building of up to 15 units with one user account, forever. No card on file required.
faq.a2: Most customers create their first real reservation within 20 minutes of signing up. If you have an existing spreadsheet, we can import it for you in one go.
faq.q3: Does Binaya handle Khareef pricing automatically?
faq.a3: Yes. Seasonal rates apply automatically between configurable date ranges, including the Jun 15 – Sep 15 Khareef window.
faq.q4: Can my team work in Arabic?
faq.a4: Yes. The entire product UI is bilingual English / Arabic with right-to-left layout. Each user picks their own language.

finalCta.description: Free for one building, forever. Set up in 20 minutes. No credit card, no sales call — just a working dashboard by lunch.

footer.tagline: Property management software built in Salalah for the way Omani property managers actually work.
